Daijishō is a retro launcher that lets you manage your retro games libraries. Daijishō cares about integrated experience, extensibility, aesthetic, and pragmatic orientation, which let you focus on the games themselves.\n\nWat? What does \'Daijishō\' even mean?, you ask? Daijishō (aka だいじしょう) actually stands for 台字章 in kanji, which was a pattern widely used in Taiwan during the Japanese period. Anyway, happy gaming.
